comparison.objective: Uncover a rice-cooker steam vent before pressing its start control.
comparison.physical_skill: Safety-precondition recognition, towel relocation, button actuation, and stable release.
comparison.success_condition: Vent cleared before activation, towel supported, button and grippers released; activation while covered permanently zeros the score. Full numeric geometric tolerances are absent from the body.
comparison.reason: Safety ordering and simple plunger actuation do not test coaxial tooling, hammer impact, controlled material separation, coil retention, or containment of detached fragments.
